# <span id="aanchor20"></span> Country Editor

The Country Editor allows you to enter country names that you can then access in areas throughout FLOWCAL, such as the Meter Editor and Location Editor.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Country Editor and modify country options:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Country Editor** in the **Geographic** group.
3.  Select a country from the list and click the **Edit** button.
4.  Update the country data at the bottom of the screen as needed.
5.  Click the **Save** button.

To create a new country:

1.  Click the **New** button.
2.  Enter the country data at the bottom of the screen.
3.  Click the **Save** button.

The country will now be available within FLOWCAL.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 378;height: 397;" />

Once created, countries cannot be deleted.

</div>
